_comment: Placeholders only. Configure provider credentials locally using TrueForge or the secure helper; never save real keys here. This is a checklist, not an import manifest.
credentialSetup: Configure NVIDIA NIM provider in TrueForge or using node scripts/configure-provider.cjs for the primary and inline models (PROVIDER_BASE_URL=https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1, PROVIDER_MODEL=nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b). Configure Google Gemini provider in TrueForge for the fallback model (google-gemini/gemini-3-8-flash). Groq is optional and not used on the default path. Credentials are stored by TrueForge, not in this file.
